```yaml
name: PR Status Labeler

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [PR Auto-Labeler]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  capture-pr-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Capture PR data
        id: capture_pr_data
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=pr_number::$(jq -r '.pull_request.number' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)"
          echo "::set-output name=repo_name::$(jq -r '.repository.full_name' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)"

  pr-status-labeler:
    needs: capture-pr-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Get PR number and repo name
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ needs.capture-pr-data.outputs.pr_number }}
          REPO_NAME=${{ needs.capture-pr-data.outputs.repo_name }}

      - name: Label PR
        uses: actions/labeler@v6
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          pr-number: ${{ PR_NUMBER }}
```
